verses.uthmani: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ
verses.indopak: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِىْ بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرُ ۙ
verses.transliteration: ﻿tabaraka allathee biyadihi almulku wahuwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeerun
verses.saheeh: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
verses.khattab: Blessed is the One in Whose Hands rests all authority. And He is Most Capable of everything
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Blessed, exalted above the attributes of created beings, is He in Whose hand, at Whose disposal, is [all] sovereignty, [all] authority and power, and He has power over all things.
verses.romanUrdu: Nihayat buzurg-o-bartar hai woh jiske haath mein qayinaat ki sultanat hai , aur woh har cheez par qudrat rakhta hai

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفُورُ
verses.indopak: ٱلَّذِىْ خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيٰوةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ اَيُّكُمْ اَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۗ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْغَفُوْرُ ۙ
verses.transliteration: allathee khalaqa almawta waalhayata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu 'amalan wahuwa al'azeezu alghafooru
verses.saheeh: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
verses.khattab: ˹He is the One˺ Who created death and life in order to test which of you is best in deeds. And He is the Almighty, All-Forgiving
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[He] Who created death, in this world, and life, in the Hereafter — or both of them in this world, since the sperm-drop is imbued with life, [life being] that [power] by which sensation becomes possible, death being the opposite of this or the non-existence of it — these being two [alternative] opinions; in the case of the latter [life in the Hereafter], ‘creation’ implies ‘ordainment’ — that He may try you, that He may test you in [this] life, [to see] which of you is best in conduct, [which of you] is most obedient to God, and He is the Mighty, in His vengeance against those who disobey Him, the Forgiving, to those who repent to Him;
verses.romanUrdu: Jisne maut aur zindagi ko ijaat kiya taa-ke tum logon ko aazma kar dekhey tum mein se kaun behtar amal karne wala hai, aur woh zabardast bhi hai aur darguzar farmane wala bhi

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٖ ۖ فَٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ هَلۡ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٖ
verses.indopak: الَّذِىْ خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًا ۗ مَا تَرٰى فِىْ خَلْقِ الرَّحْمٰنِ مِنْ تَفٰوُتٍ ۗ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ ۙ هَلْ تَرٰى مِنْ فُطُوْرٍ
verses.transliteration: allathee khalaqa sab'a samawatin tibaqan ma tara fee khalqi alrrahmani min tafawutin fairji'i albasara hal tara min futoorin
verses.saheeh: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
verses.khattab: ˹He is the One˺ Who created seven heavens, one above the other. You will never see any imperfection in the creation of the Most Compassionate. So look again: do you see any flaws
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Who created seven heavens in layers, one above the other without any contact [between them]. You do not see in the Compassionate One’s creation, of these or of other things, any irregularity, any disparity or discordance. Then cast your eyes again, turn them toward the heaven: Do you see, in it, any fissure?, any cracks or ruptures?
verses.romanUrdu: Jisne teh-bar-teh saat (seven) aasman banaye tum Rehman ki takhleeq(creation) mein kisi kism ki be-rabti (incongruity) na paogey phir palat kar dekho, kahin tumhein koi khalal (flaw) nazar aata hai

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنقَلِبۡ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئٗا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٞ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنْقَلِبْ اِلَيْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَّهُوَ حَسِيْرٌ
verses.transliteration: thumma irji'i albasara karratayni yanqalib ilayka albasaru khasian wahuwa haseerun
verses.saheeh: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
verses.khattab: Then look again and again—your sight will return frustrated and weary
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then cast your eyes yet again, once and then twice, and your sight will return to you humbled, abject on account of it not perceiving any fissure, and wearied, unable to see any fissure.
verses.romanUrdu: Baar baar nigaah daudao tumhari nigaah thak kar na-murad palat aayegi

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا رُجُومٗا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.indopak: وَلَـقَدْ زَيَّـنَّا السَّمَاۤءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيْحَ وَجَعَلْنٰهَا رُجُوْمًا لِّلشَّيٰطِيْنِ وَاَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيْرِ
verses.transliteration: walaqad zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bimasabeeha waja'alnaha rujooman lilshshayateeni waa'tadna lahum 'athaba alssa'eeri
verses.saheeh: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
verses.khattab: And indeed, We adorned the lowest heaven with ˹stars like˺ lamps, and made them ˹as missiles˺ for stoning ˹eavesdropping˺ devils, for whom We have also prepared the torment of the Blaze
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We have adorned the lowest heaven, the one closest to the earth, with lamps, with stars, and made them missiles against the devils, should they [attempt to] listen by stealth, in which case a meteor of fire detaches itself from the star, just like a brand is taken from a fire, and either kills that jinn or deprives him of his senses: it is not that the star itself is displaced from its position; and We have prepared for them the chastisement of the Blaze, the ignited Fire.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne tumhare kareeb ke aasman ko azeem-o-shaan chiragon se aarasta (adorned /beautify) kiya hai aur unhein shayateen ko maar bhagane ka zariya bana diya hai. In shaytano ke liye bhadakti hui aag humne muhayya kar rakkhi hai

verses.uthmani: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
verses.indopak: وَلِلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۗ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيْرُ
verses.transliteration: walillatheena kafaroo birabbihim 'athabu jahannama wabisa almaseeru
verses.saheeh: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
verses.khattab: Those who disbelieve in their Lord will suffer the punishment of Hell. What an evil destination
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there is the chastisement of Hell, and [what] an evil journey’s end!, it is.
verses.romanUrdu: Jin logon ne apne Rubb se kufr kiya hai unke liye jahannum ka azaab hai aur woh bahut hi bura thikana hai

verses.uthmani: إِذَآ أُلۡقُواْ فِيهَا سَمِعُواْ لَهَا شَهِيقٗا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ
verses.indopak: اِذَاۤ اُلْقُوْا فِيْهَا سَمِعُوْا لَهَا شَهِيْقًا وَّهِىَ تَفُوْرُ ۙ
verses.transliteration: itha olqoo feeha sami'oo laha shaheeqan wahiya tafooru
verses.saheeh: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.
verses.khattab: When they are tossed into it, they will hear its roaring as it boils over
verses.jalalayn: ﻿When they are flung into it they hear it blaring, [producing] a horrid sound like that of an ass, as it seethes,
verses.romanUrdu: Jab woh usmein phenke jayenge to uske dhahadne (roar) ki haulnaak aawaz sunengey aur woh josh kha rahi hogi

verses.uthmani: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلۡقِيَ فِيهَا فَوۡجٞ سَأَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ
verses.indopak: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ ۗ كُلَّمَاۤ اُلْقِىَ فِيْهَا فَوْجٌ سَاَلَهُمْ خَزَنَـتُهَاۤ اَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيْرٌ
verses.transliteration: takadu tamayyazu mina alghaythi kullama olqiya feeha fawjun saalahum khazanatuha alam yatikum natheerun
verses.saheeh: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"
verses.khattab: almost bursting in fury. Every time a group is cast into it, its keepers will ask them, “Did a warner not come to you?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿almost exploding (tamayyazu: a variant reading has the original [form] tatamayyazu) ripped apart, with rage, in wrath against the disbelievers. Whenever a host, a group of them, is flung into it, its keepers ask them, an interrogation of rebuke: ‘Did there not come to you a warner?’, a messenger to warn you of God’s chastisement.
verses.romanUrdu: Shiddat-e-gazab se phati jati hogi, har baar jab koi anbwah (multitude/group) us mein dala jayega uske kaarinde (keepers) un logon se puchenge “kya tumhare paas koi khabardaar karne wala nahin aaya tha?”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٞ فَكَذَّبۡنَا وَقُلۡنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ كَبِيرٖ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا بَلٰى قَدْ جَاۤءَنَا نَذِيْرٌ ۙ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ شَىْءٍ ۖ اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا فِىْ ضَلٰلٍ كَبِيْرٍ
verses.transliteration: qaloo bala qad jaana natheerun fakaththabna waqulna ma nazzala allahu min shayin in antum illa fee dalalin kabeerin
verses.saheeh: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"
verses.khattab: They will reply, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we denied and said, ‘Allah has revealed nothing. You are extremely astray.’”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They will say, ‘Yes, a warner did indeed come to us, but we denied and said, “God has not revealed anything; you are assuredly in great error”’: this [last words] may be the words of the angels [spoken] to the disbelievers when they are told of the denial, or they may belong to the words of the disbelievers [spoken] to the warners.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh jawab denge “haan ,khabardaar karne wala hamare paas aaya tha,magar humne usey jhutla diya aur kaha Allah ne kuch bhi nazil nahin kiya hai, tum badi gumraahi mein padey huey ho”

verses.uthmani: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ كُنَّا نَسۡمَعُ أَوۡ نَعۡقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.indopak: وَقَالُوْا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ اَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىْۤ اَصْحٰبِ السَّعِيْرِ
verses.transliteration: waqaloo law kunna nasma'u aw na'qilu ma kunna fee ashabi alssa'eeri
verses.saheeh: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
verses.khattab: And they will lament, “If only we had listened and reasoned, we would not be among the residents of the Blaze!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they will say, ‘Had we listened, that is, listening so as to understand, or comprehended, that is, comprehension entailing reflection [upon the truth], we would not have been among the inhabitants of the Blaze’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur woh kahenge “kaash hum sunte ya samajhte to aaj is bhadakti hui aag ke sazawaron mein na shamil hotey”

verses.uthmani: فَٱعۡتَرَفُواْ بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسُحۡقٗا لِّأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.indopak: فَاعْتَرَفُوْا بِذَنْبِۢهِمْ ۚ فَسُحْقًا لِّاَصْحٰبِ السَّعِيْرِ
verses.transliteration: fai'tarafoo bithanbihim fasuhqan liashabi alssa'eeri
verses.saheeh: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.
verses.khattab: And so they will confess their sins. So away with the residents of the Blaze
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thus they will confess, when confession is of no avail, their sin, which was their denial of the warners. So away (suhqan or suhuqan) with the inhabitants of the Blaze!, so far away may they be from God’s mercy.
verses.romanUrdu: Is tarah woh apne kasoor ka khud aitraaf (confess) kar lengey, laanat hai in dozakhiyon par

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَأَجۡرٞ كَبِيرٞ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَّاَجْرٌ كَبِيْرٌ
verses.transliteration: inna allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeerun
verses.saheeh: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
verses.khattab: Indeed, those in awe of their Lord without seeing Him will have forgiveness and a mighty reward
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly those who fear their Lord in secret, while they are absent from people’s eyes, being obedient to Him in secret, such that openly [before people] it is all the more likely [that they fear their Lord] — there will be for them forgiveness and a great reward, namely, Paradise.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo log be-dekhe apne Rubb se darte hai , yaqeenan unke liye magfirat hai aur bada ajar

verses.uthmani: وَأَسِرُّواْ قَوۡلَكُمۡ أَوِ ٱجۡهَرُواْ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.indopak: وَاَسِرُّوْا قَوْلَـكُمْ اَوِ اجْهَرُوْا بِهٖ ۗ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيْمٌ بِۢذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ
verses.transliteration: waasirroo qawlakum awi ijharoo bihi innahu 'aleemun bithati alssudoori
verses.saheeh: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.khattab: Whether you speak secretly or openly—He surely knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And [whether you] keep secret, O people, your speech or proclaim it, He indeed, exalted be He, is Knower of what is in the breasts, of what they contain: so how much more so [is He Knower] in the case of what you utter [openly] — the reason for the revelation of this [verse] was that the idolaters said to one another: ‘Speak secretly, and Muhammad’s god will not hear you’.
verses.romanUrdu: Tum khwah chupke se baat karo ya unchi aawaz se (Allah ke liye yaksa hai) woh to dilon ka haal tak jaanta hai

verses.uthmani: أَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ
verses.indopak: اَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ ۗ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيْفُ الْخَبِيْرُ
verses.transliteration: ala ya'lamu man khalaqa wahuwa allateefu alkhabeeru
verses.saheeh: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?
verses.khattab: How could He not know His Own creation? For He ˹alone˺ is the Most Subtle, All-Aware
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Will He Who has created not know?, what you keep secret, in other words: will His knowledge of [things] be precluded by such [secret speech]? And He is the Subtle, in His knowledge, the Aware, therein.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya wahi na jaanega jisne paida kiya hai? Halanke woh baareek-been aur bakhabar hai

verses.uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ ذَلُولٗا فَٱمۡشُواْ فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُواْ مِن رِّزۡقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
verses.indopak: هُوَ الَّذِىْ جَعَلَ لَـكُمُ الْاَرْضَ ذَلُوْلًا فَامْشُوْا فِىْ مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوْا مِنْ رِّزْقِهٖ ۗ وَاِلَيْهِ النُّشُوْرُ
verses.transliteration: huwa allathee ja'ala lakumu alarda thaloolan faimshoo fee manakibiha wakuloo min rizqihi wailayhi alnnushooru
verses.saheeh: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
verses.khattab: He is the One Who smoothed out the earth for you, so move about in its regions and eat from His provisions. And to Him is the resurrection ˹of all˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿It is He Who made the earth tractable for you, easy for you to walk on; so walk in its flanks and eat of His provision, that has been created for you; and to Him is the resurrection, from the graves for the Requital.
verses.romanUrdu: Wahi to hai jisne tumhare liye zameen ko taabeh kar rakkha hai , chalo uski chaati par aur khao khuda ka rizq, usi ke huzoor tumhein dobara zinda ho kar jana hai

verses.uthmani: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ
verses.indopak: ءَاَمِنْتُمْ مَّنْ فِى السَّمَاۤءِ اَنْ يَّخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْاَرْضَ فَاِذَا هِىَ تَمُوْرُ ۙ
verses.transliteration: aamintum man fee alssamai an yakhsifa bikumu alarda faitha hiya tamooru
verses.saheeh: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
verses.khattab: Do you feel secure that the One Who is in heaven will not cause the earth to swallow you up as it quakes violently
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Are you secure (read a-amintum pronouncing both hamzas fully, or by not pronouncing the second one, inserting an alif between it and the other one, or without [the insertion] but replacing it with an alif instead) [in thinking] that He Who is in the heaven, [that He] Whose authority and power [is in the heaven], will not cause the earth to swallow you (an yakhsifa substitutes for man, ‘He Who’) while it quakes?, [while] it moves underneath you and rises above you?
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tum issey be-khauf ho ke woh jo aasman mein hai tumhein zameen mein dhasa de aur yakayak yeh zameen jhakoley khane lagey (shake/rock violently)

verses.uthmani: أَمۡ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبٗا ۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ كَيۡفَ نَذِيرِ
verses.indopak: اَمْ اَمِنْتُمْ مَّنْ فِى السَّمَاۤءِ اَنْ يُّرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ۗ فَسَتَعْلَمُوْنَ كَيْفَ نَذِيْرِ
verses.transliteration: am amintum man fee alssamai an yursila 'alaykum hasiban fasata'lamoona kayfa natheeri
verses.saheeh: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
verses.khattab: Or do you feel secure that the One Who is in heaven will not unleash upon you a storm of stones. Only then would you know how ˹serious˺ My warning was
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Are you secure [in thinking] that He Who is in the heaven will not unleash (an yursila substitutes for man, ‘He Who’) upon you a squall of pebbles?, a wind hurling pebbles at you. But you will [soon] come to know, upon seeing the chastisement with your own eyes, the nature of My warning, My warning of chastisement, in other words, [you will soon see] that it was true.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tum issey be-khauf ho ke wo jo aasman mein hai tum par pathrao karne wali hawa bhej de? Phir tumhein maloom ho jayega ke meri tambeeh (warning) kaisi hoti hai

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.indopak: وَلَـقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيْرِ
verses.transliteration: walaqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim fakayfa kana nakeeri
verses.saheeh: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
verses.khattab: And certainly those before them denied ˹as well˺, then how severe was My response
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily those, communities, who were before them denied, then [see] how was My rebuttal!, [how was] My rebuttal of them in destroying them when they denied: in other words, [how] it was true.
verses.romanUrdu: Inse pehle guzre huey log jhutla chuke hain phir dekhlo ke meri giraft kaisi sakht thi

verses.uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ صَٰٓفَّٰتٖ وَيَقۡبِضۡنَ ۚ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءِۭ بَصِيرٌ
verses.indopak: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صٰٓـفّٰتٍ وَّيَقْبِضْنَ ۘ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ اِلَّا الرَّحْمٰنُ ۗ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ بَصِيْرٌ
verses.transliteration: awalam yaraw ila alttayri fawqahum saffatin wayaqbidna ma yumsikuhunna illa alrrahmanu innahu bikulli shayin baseerun
verses.saheeh: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
verses.khattab: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading and folding their wings? None holds them up except the Most Compassionate. Indeed, He is All-Seeing of everything
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or have they not seen the birds above them, in the air, spreading their wings and closing?, their wings after spreading them? (in other words [read wa-yaqbidna] as wa-qābidātin [similar to sāffātin, ‘spreading’]). Nothing sustains them, from falling, either when they are spreading them or closing them, except the Compassionate One, by His power. Indeed He is Seer of all things. The meaning is: have they not inferred from the fact that the birds [are able to] remain in the air that We have the power to do with them what has been mentioned above as well as [inflicting upon them] other kinds of chastisement?
verses.romanUrdu: Kya yeh log apne upar udney waley parindon ko par phaylaye aur sukedte nahin dekhte? Rehman ke siwa koi nahin jo inhein thamey huey ho. Wahi har cheez ka nigehbaan hai

verses.uthmani: أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ جُندٞ لَّكُمۡ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ
verses.indopak: اَمَّنْ هٰذَا الَّذِىْ هُوَ جُنْدٌ لَّكُمْ يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ الرَّحْمٰنِ ۗ اِنِ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ اِلَّا فِىْ غُرُوْرٍ ۚ
verses.transliteration: amman hatha allathee huwa jundun lakum yansurukum min dooni alrrahmani ini alkafiroona illa fee ghuroorin
verses.saheeh: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
verses.khattab: Also, which ˹powerless˺ force will come to your help instead of the Most Compassionate? Indeed, the disbelievers are only ˹lost˺ in delusion
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or who (am-man: the subject) is it (hādhā: its predicate) that (alladhī: a substitution for hādhā, ‘is it’) will be an army, supporters, for you (lakum belongs to the relative clause of alladhī, ‘that’) to help you (yansurukum is an adjectival qualification of jundun, ‘an army’) besides the Compassionate One?, that is to say, other than Him, who [is there that] will [be able to] avert His chastisement from you, in other words, you have no helper. The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion: Satan has deluded them [into believing] that the chastisement will not befall them.
verses.romanUrdu: Batao, aakhir woh kaunsa lashkar tumhare paas hai jo Rehman ke muqable mein tumhari madad kar sakta hai? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh mukireen dhoke mein padey huey hain

verses.uthmani: أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَرۡزُقُكُمۡ إِنۡ أَمۡسَكَ رِزۡقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّواْ فِي عُتُوّٖ وَنُفُورٍ
verses.indopak: اَمَّنْ هٰذَا الَّذِىْ يَرْزُقُكُمْ اِنْ اَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهٗ ۚ بَلْ لَّجُّوْا فِىْ عُتُوٍّ وَّنُفُوْرٍ
verses.transliteration: amman hatha allathee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqahu bal lajjoo fee 'utuwwin wanufoorin
verses.saheeh: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
verses.khattab: Or who is it that will provide for you if He withholds His provision? In fact, they persist in arrogance and aversion ˹to the truth˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or who is it that will provide for you if He, the Compassionate One, withholds His provision?, that is to say, [if He withholds] the rain from you (the response to the conditional has been omitted, but is indicated by what preceded it, namely [the statement to the effect] ‘who will provide for you?’, and so [the response would be]: you have no provider other than Him. Nay, but they persist in disdain and aversion, moving away [further] from the truth.
verses.romanUrdu: Ya phir batao, kaun hai jo tumhein rizq de sakta hai agar Rehman apna rizq roak ley? Dar-asal yeh log sarkashi aur haqq se gurez par adey huey hai

verses.uthmani: أَفَمَن يَمۡشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦٓ أَهۡدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمۡشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
verses.indopak: اَفَمَنْ يَّمْشِىْ مُكِبًّا عَلٰى وَجْهِهٖۤ اَهْدٰۤى اَمَّنْ يَّمْشِىْ سَوِيًّا عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ
verses.transliteration: afaman yamshee mukibban 'ala wajhihi ahda amman yamshee sawiyyan 'ala siratin mustaqeemin
verses.saheeh: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
verses.khattab: Who is ˹rightly˺ guided: the one who crawls facedown or the one who walks upright on the Straight Path
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Is he who walks cast down, fallen, on his face more rightly guided, or he who walks upright on a straight path? (the predicate of the second man, ‘who’, has been omitted, but is indicated by the predicate of the first, namely, ahdā, ‘more rightly guided’; the similitude refers to the believer and the disbeliever and to which of the two is more rightly guided).
verses.romanUrdu: Bhala socho, jo shaks mooh aundhaey (grovelling) chal raha ho woh zyada sahih raah paney wala hai ya woh jo sar uthaye seedha ek hamwar sadak par chal raha ho

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَكُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ
verses.indopak: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِىْۤ اَنْشَاَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَـكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَ الْاَفْـــِٕدَةَ ۗ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qul huwa allathee anshaakum waja'ala lakumu alssam'a waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona
verses.saheeh: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “He is the One Who brought you into being and gave you hearing, sight, and intellect. ˹Yet˺ you hardly give any thanks.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘It is He Who created you and endowed you with hearing and sight and hearts. Little do you thank!’ (mā tashkurūna: mā is extra; the sentence itself is a new [independent] one, informing of how extremely little they give thanks for these graces).
verses.romanUrdu: Inse kaho Allah hi hai jisne tumhein paida kiya, tumko sunney aur dekhne ki taaqatein di aur sochne samajhne waley dil diye, magar tum kam hi shukr ada karte ho

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ
verses.indopak: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِىْ ذَرَاَكُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَاِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qul huwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona
verses.saheeh: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."
verses.khattab: ˹Also˺ say, “He is the One Who has dispersed you ˹all˺ over the earth, and to Him you will ˹all˺ be gathered.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘It is He Who multiplied you, created you, on earth, and to Him you will be gathered’, for the Reckoning.
verses.romanUrdu: Insey kaho, Allah hi hai jisne tumhein zameen mein phailaya hai aur usi ki taraf tum sametey jaogey

verses.uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.indopak: وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wayaqooloona mata hatha alwa'du in kuntum sadiqeena
verses.saheeh: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.khattab: ˹Still˺ they ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they say, to the believers: ‘When will this promise be [fulfilled], the promise of the gathering, if you are truthful?’, about it.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh kehte hain “Agar tum sacchey ho to batao yeh wada kab poora hoga?”

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡعِلۡمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.indopak: قُلْ اِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ ۖ وَاِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا۠ نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
verses.transliteration: qul innama al'ilmu 'inda allahi wainnama ana natheerun mubeenun
verses.saheeh: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “That knowledge is with Allah alone, and I am only sent with a clear warning.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘The knowledge, of its coming, is only with God, and I am but a plain warner’, one whose warning is plain.
verses.romanUrdu: Kaho “Iska ilm to Allah ke paas hai, main to bas saaf saaf khabardar kardene wala hoon

verses.uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهُ زُلۡفَةٗ سِيٓـَٔتۡ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
verses.indopak: فَلَمَّا رَاَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِیْٓــَٔتْ وُجُوْهُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَقِيْلَ هٰذَا الَّذِىْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تَدَّعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: falamma raawhu zulfatan seeat wujoohu allatheena kafaroo waqeela hatha allathee kuntum bihi tadda'oona
verses.saheeh: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."
verses.khattab: Then when they see the torment drawing near, the faces of the disbelievers will become gloomy, and it will be said ˹to them˺, “This is what you claimed would never come.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But when they see it, that is, the chastisement, after the gathering, near at hand, the faces of those who disbelieved will be awry, blackened, and it will be said, that is, the keepers [of Hell] will say to them: ‘This is that, chastisement, which, the warning of which, you used to make claims about’, [claims to the effect] that you would not be resurrected — this is the narration of a situation that will take place [in the future], and which has been expressed using the past tense in order to confirm that it will actually take place.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir jab yeh us cheez ko kareeb dekh lenge to un sab logon ke chehre bigad jayenge jinhon ne inkar kiya hai, aur us waqt unse kaha jayega ke yahi hai woh cheez jiske liye tum takazey kar rahey (ask for) thay

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَهۡلَكَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوۡ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
verses.indopak: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِنْ اَهْلَـكَنِىَ اللّٰهُ وَمَنْ مَّعِىَ اَوْ رَحِمَنَا ۙ فَمَنْ يُّجِيْرُ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ
verses.transliteration: qul araaytum in ahlakaniya allahu waman ma'iya aw rahimana faman yujeeru alkafireena min 'athabin aleemin
verses.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Consider this: whether Allah causes me and those with me to die or shows us mercy, who will save the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘Have you considered: If God destroys me and those with me, of believers, by His chastisement, as you would have it, or has mercy on us, and does not chastise us, who then will protect the disbelievers from a painful chastisement?’: in other words, they will have no protector from it.
verses.romanUrdu: Insey kaho, kabhi tumne yeh bhi socha ke Allah khwa mujhey aur mere saathiyon ko halaaq karde ya hum par Reham karey, kafiron ko dardnaak azaab se kaun bacha lega

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَا ۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
verses.indopak: قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمٰنُ اٰمَنَّا بِهٖ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۚ فَسَتَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ هُوَ فِىْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
verses.transliteration: qul huwa alrrahmanu amanna bihi wa'alayhi tawakkalna fasata'lamoona man huwa fee dalalin mubeenin
verses.saheeh: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
verses.khattab: Say, “He is the Most Compassionate—in Him ˹alone˺ we believe, and in Him ˹alone˺ we trust. You will soon know who is clearly astray.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘He is the Compassionate One; we believe in Him, and in Him we put our trust. And assuredly you will [soon] know (sa-ta‘lamūna is also read sa-ya‘lamūna, ‘they will know’) upon seeing the chastisement with your own eyes, who is in manifest error’: is it us, or yourselves or them?
verses.romanUrdu: Insey kaho, woh bada Raheem hai, usi par hum imaan laye hain, aur usi par hamara bharosa hai, ankareeb tumhein maloom ho jayega ke sareeh gumrahi (manifest error) mein pada hua kaun hai

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَصۡبَحَ مَآؤُكُمۡ غَوۡرٗا فَمَن يَأۡتِيكُم بِمَآءٖ مَّعِينِۭ
verses.indopak: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِنْ اَصْبَحَ مَاۤؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَنْ يَّأْتِيْكُمْ بِمَاۤءٍ مَّعِيْنٍ
verses.transliteration: qul araaytum in asbaha maokum ghawran faman yateekum bimain ma'eenin
verses.saheeh: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
verses.khattab: Say, “Consider this: if your water were to sink ˹into the earth˺, then who ˹else˺ could bring you flowing water?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘Have you considered: If your water were to sink deep into the earth, who then will bring you running water?’, which hands and buckets would be able to reach, like [they do] your water: in other words, none but God, exalted be He, would be able to bring it, so how can you reject that He will resurrect you? It is commendable for one to say Allāhu rabbu’l-‘ālamīna, ‘God, Lord of the Worlds!’, after ma‘īn, ‘running water’, as is stated in a hadīth. This verse was recited before a certain tyrant who then replied, ‘Hatchets and pickaxes will bring it!’, whereupon the water of his eyes dried up and he became blind. We seek refuge with God against that we should be insolent towards Him or His verses.
verses.romanUrdu: Inse kaho, kabhi tumne yeh bhi socha ke agar tumhare kuwon (wells) ka pani zameen mein utar jaye to kaun hai jo is pani ki behti hui sotein (flowing water) tumhein nikal kar la dega
